notes:
Inbound SMB lead — rapid growth DTC ecommerce. Signed up self-serve, started trial. Primary ask: cut token costs without hurting response quality. Customer quote: "We see spikes up to ~$500/day on product Q&A — need to get that down." Cost optimization focus: batching, prefix/KV caching, prompt compression and a token usage audit.

Key context:
- Product: on-site shopping assistant (chat) + product embeddings for search/rerank. Heavy short-session chat traffic (lots of repeated prefixes). Embedding calls on purchase flows.
- Current infra: public cloud only; primarily AWS us-east. No VPC or on-prem requirement.
- Security: SMB wants SOC2 attestation and basic audit logs; not asking for SSO yet.
- Performance targets: p95 latency <= 350ms for chat; throughput 80 reqs/min peak per region.
- Cost sensitivity: Very high. Budget planning for Q2; target reduce token spend 30-50%.

What we've proposed:
- Hosted API + Redwood Optimize quick audit: run token-usage analysis on last 7 days, return top-10 prompt hotspots and suggested compressions.
- Batching: suggest client SDK batching for low-latency groupings (max group window 50ms) and server-side continuous batching for embeddings.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache for product-context prompts (detect 70% repeated prefixes). TTL and hit-rate monitoring.
- Prompt compression: canonicalize product prompts (templating + slot compression), remove redundant system tokens, recommend short-form embeddings for similar queries.
- Rollout plan: 2-week POC. Week 1: token audit + server-side batching enabled in staged traffic. Week 2: measure cost delta, apply prompt compressions and caching, evaluate quality regressions.

Stated acceptance criteria (customer):
- >=30% token cost reduction on chat and embeddings combined OR monthly cost under $5k for projected volume.
- No perceived quality drop by CS team (sample prompt set evaluation).
- Basic audit logs enabled for trial traffic.

Open items / asks from customer:
- Provide a sample token-usage CSV and a short script to map tokens to flows (they asked for a one-click audit run).
- Example SLA for hosted plan (legal).
- Quick SOC2/attestation FAQ for procurement.

Action items:
- AE (Avery): share cost-audit template + pricing scenarios (today)
- SE (Rohit): prepare quick-run batching config + sample code (by 2026-03-07)
- Schedule POC kickoff 30m w/ CTO + eng leads (target 2026-03-09)

Stitch links: pricing deck in drive; fireflies call ff-83412 contains CTO comment about "spike during flash sales". Jira JIRA-3312 created to track initial billing/usage anomaly analysis.
